drafted_from: workflow:file-what-needs-the-person's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:file-what-needs-the-person on this plan: bring 50 paper boxes to the market stall on Saturday and sign the stall form."

lists.label: Waiting on you
lists.holds: One thing only the person can finish, with why, how they finish it and what was tried first.

values.why: The market only accepts a form signed by the shop owner.
values.only_you_because: A signature is your own consent
values.tried: Filled in every other field from the shop facts; the signature line stayed empty.
values.done_when: The signed form is sent back

values.what: Tap to order 50 paper bakery boxes for 41.50
values.why: The plan says to bring boxes by Saturday.
values.tried: Found the store, built the order up to payment.

instructions: 1. Pour the example rows into the list where you keep things waiting on you (see pour), or make list:waiting-on-you from them.
2. Before any message or plan tells you to do something, say "Run workflow:file-what-needs-the-person" with the sentence in said.

3. The AI works steps, weigh, do, judge, file, tell and take-there: it splits the sentence into steps, does every step it can, keeps only last-resort or better-from-you steps as one fully explained row each, and tells you only your part.
4. Read the card it opens for the oldest row and finish it the way its finish field says.

worked_examples.title: One step is done for you and one stays as your signature
worked_examples.ask: File what this plan has me doing.

input.said: Bring 50 paper boxes to the market stall on Saturday and sign the stall form.

worked_examples.given: The steps step split the sentence into "Bring 50 paper boxes to the stall" (needs a purchase and a tap) and "Sign the stall form" (needs a signature). The do step prepared the box order up to its price as one Waiting on you row; read from the judge step of the workflow row. The person's messages and decisions hold no signed yes for the stall form.
worked_examples.hands_back: The submit shape of step judge: {"left":[{"step":"Sign the stall form","because":"last-resort","reason":"Only the shop owner can sign for the shop; a signature is their own consent.","searched":"Searched the person's messages and decisions for a signed yes about the stall form and found none."}]}

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
